book.name: 1Tasolonqe Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Tasolonqe Asaas Xaafida Koyro Kiita

content: Hessa gishshas nuus dandayettontta ixxiin he wode Ateenan nurkka nu attanayssi nuus lo7o gidi beettides.
Inttena ammanon minththana mala nunara asas Kirstoosa mishiraachcho qaalaa yootiza Xoossa ashkara gidida Ximtoosa intteko yeddidos.
Hessika hayssa paacezan oonikka ammanoppe qanxxontta malassa; nunikka hayssas doorettidayssa intteka ereeta.
Nu qasse inttenara diza wode waayey nu bolla gakkanayssa kasetidi inttes yootidos; intte eriza malakka hanides.

Hessa gishshas ta aykkoka genceciin taas dandayettontta ixxida gishshas intte ammano gishshas eranaas gaada Ximtoosa kiittadis; ta hessa ooththiday oonee erizay paaccizaadey istta paacciin hanni wode nu daaburay wurikka hada gidontta aggenna gaada babbida gishshassa.

Ha7i qasse Ximtoosi intte achchafe nuukko yiidi intte ammano gishshassinne intte siiqoteththaa gishshas lo7o wore nuna sissides. Qasseka intte ubba wode nuna lo7eththi qoppizayssanne nunikka inttena beyanaas laamotiza mala intteka nuna beyanaas laamotizayssa nuus yootides.
Hessa gishshas nu ishatoo! Nu dizay waayeninne meto garsan gidikkoka intte ammano gaason inttenan ha7i nu minettoos.
Intte Godaan minni eqqida gishshas tumappe ha7i nu paxa daana.
Intte gaason nu Xoossa sinththan nu demmida ubba ufayssaa gishshas Xoossa ay mala galatanaas dandayzonii?
Qasseka nu inttena beyanaassinne intte ammanoppe paccidayssa kunththanaas omarsinne gallas keehi woossoos.
Ha7ikka nu intteko baana mala nu Aaway Xoossi Godaa Yesus Kirstoosi ogeza izi nuus suuriso.
Nu inttena siiqiza mala inttes intte garsan diza siiqonne intte harata siiqiza siiqoza Goday darsonne keehi gujjo.
Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosi geeshshata ubbatara yiza wode nu Aawaa Godaa Xoossaa sinththan intte wosoy bayndaytanne geeshshata gididi beettana mala intte wozina izi minththo.
